tui.usage_refusal.not_sent.role: refusal receipt naming the account: the reset request was never sent
tui.usage_refusal.not_sent.tone: States the certain fact (nothing was spent) and never implies an unknown outcome; short enough for a 50-cell band row.
tui.usage_refusal.not_sent.note: Only used for a refusal decided BEFORE anything reached the wire: no stored login, an ambiguous label, an unmintable token, a provider with no reset product. A transport error keeps tui.usage.resets.failed, whose outcome really is unknown. Its own namespace, not a tui.usage key: it ships audited in all seven locales, and adding it to tui.usage would have invalidated that namespace's audited ledger row for every locale at once -- one namespace per wave is how the i18n gate audits (docs/design/i18n.md §6 amendment).
